response.rationale: R3 is directly supported by biopsy-proven endometriosis and a documented history, providing definitive pathology. R5 is a downstream complication with imaging evidence but not the underlying cause. R1 is contradicted by laparoscopy, while R2 and R4 are only listed in the differential without confirmatory findings. C1 is a redundant distribution modifier of R3.

rejected.why: Redundant append-only completion of R3 with no additional raw support beyond the same biopsy span.
